question: When was the Dronacharya Award instituted in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1985**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Dronacharya Award was instituted in **1985** by the Government of India to honor outstanding coaches in sports and games.
 
• It is named after **Dronacharya**, the legendary mentor from the Indian epic Mahabharata, symbolizing excellence in coaching.
 
• The award recognizes coaches who have produced medal-winning athletes at international events like the Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games.
 
• Recipients of the award receive a cash prize, a bronze statuette of Dronacharya, and a certificate of merit.
 
• The selection process is conducted annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**:

 
 
• Instituted in 1991-92, it is India’s highest sporting honor, awarded for outstanding performance over a period of four years.
 
• Recipients receive a medallion, certificate, and cash prize.
 
• The award was renamed **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** in 2021.
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Award**:
 
 
• Established in 1961, it honors athletes for consistent performance in national and international events.
 
• Recipients are awarded a bronze statuette, certificate, and cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Award**:
 
 
• Introduced in 2002, it is given for lifetime achievement in sports and games.
 
• Named after Major Dhyan Chand, a legendary hockey player.
 
 
 
• **National Sports Day**:
 
 
• Celebrated annually on **August 29**, marking the birth anniversary of Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• On this day, major sports awards like the Dronacharya, Arjuna, and Khel Ratna are presented.
